scenes.description: An old cloth shoulder bag falling apart, with frayed seams, torn fabric, worn straps and loose threads. One clearly visible tattered bag on a plain surface.
A cookie sheds uneven pieces and crumbs as one hand lifts it above a plate.
A weary person slumps over a worktable with both hands covering part of their face.
Distinct tears run from a person's cheeks toward a tissue held below their chin.
